name: nagp-website
description: NAGP website (preview) - Cloudflare Pages + Functions + D1

scripts.dev: node build.mjs && wrangler pages dev dist --d1 DB=nagp-local --binding DEMO_MODE=true --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/state --compatibility-date=2025-09-01
scripts.deploy: node build.mjs --strict && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name nagp-preview
